items.evidence: Valid apiLevel 2.13 (via requirements), every volume uses a suitable pipette (p20 for ≤19 µL, p300 for 40/106/250 µL), no well exceeds capacity, and the simulator passed with no overdispense or empty-aspirate errors.

The no_cross_contamination check failed [(395,'D2'),(396,'B1'),(397,'B1')]: the gg_enzyme transfer uses new_tip='once' with mix_after=(5,15), so one tip mixes in assembly wells and then returns to the enzyme stock D2 and the next wells.

The protocol deviates from the paper: fragments are eluted in 15 µL instead of 10 µL, the full 10 µL assembly eluate is transformed (the paper uses 5 µL), and the enzyme tip is reused across assembly wells; the end_state checks for assembly_plate and cells_plate also differ.
Master mix gives 19 µL per reaction, then 2.5 µL of each 1 µM primer and 1 µL of 0.5 ng/µL template give 25 µL, with the primer and template mapping taken from the design table.

Comment records 98 C 30 s, 36 cycles with gradient annealing, 72 C 5 min; DpnI uses 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart and 1 µL DpnI, with 37 C 30 min then 65 C 20 min; a pause for Zymo cleanup follows, in that order.
Each assembly gets 7 µL water, 2 µL 10X T4 buffer, 1 µL enzyme mix and fragments 3+2+3+2 µL from the design table, totalling 20 µL in its own well.
Records a Golden Gate program (30 cycles of 37/16 C, 60 C, 4 C hold), cleanup eluted in 10 µL, transfer to TOP10 cells, 30 min ice, 42 C 60 s, 250 µL LB+dextrose, 37 C 60 min, plating on kanamycin.

judge.summary: The protocol is sound on volumes, PCR setup, DpnI, assembly mix and the cycling/transformation steps. It fails tips because the enzyme-mix transfer reuses one tip across mixing in assembly wells and the enzyme stock, which the measured contamination check flagged, and it fails fidelity because of the 15 µL fragment elution and the full 10 µL transformed.
